options.title: Quiet oak retreat
options.description: A low ivory headboard, floating pale oak bedsides and soft opal light.
options.style: Wide low upholstered ivory linen headboard around 1.15m high, finely stitched border, simple softly rounded floating pale oak bedside drawers with creamy limestone tops, small opal globe bedside lamps with slim bronze bases, ivory duvet and taupe throw, pale oak plank floor and wool rug. A clean understated continuation of the kitchen.

options.title: Tailored linen
options.description: Soft vertical upholstery, integrated reading lights and crisp bedding.
options.style: Headboard formed of three broad vertical upholstered oatmeal linen panels, height 1.45m (not ceiling height), pale oak floating drawer bedsides with discreet integrated bronze reading lights and tiny wall switches, elegant cream bedding with narrow taupe piping, loosely folded sand throw, pale oak flooring and ivory rug. Precise modern tailoring.

options.title: Oak & stone
options.description: A wide oak headwall with a warm limestone ledge.
options.style: Low full-width straight-grain pale oak headwall 1.20m high, softly inset ivory upholstered headrest, continuous very shallow honed limestone ledge leading into small bedside drawers, minimal warm opal cylindrical lamps. Keep window reveal and sill clear. Modern architectural horizontal composition, tactile linen bedding, pale oak floor and soft wool rug.

options.title: Soft sculpted
options.description: Rounded upholstery and curved oak bedside tables.
options.style: A generously padded rounded-corner ivory headboard, softly rounded upholstered bed base, rounded freestanding pale oak bedside cabinets with oval warm stone tops, sculptural cream ceramic table lamps. Warm ivory bed linen, stone-beige throw, pale oak floor, thick ivory wool rug. Contemporary soft curves with no arches or changes to architecture.

options.title: Fine oak rhythm
options.description: Fine vertical oak detailing balanced by a plain linen headboard.
options.style: Fine closely spaced natural pale oak fluting behind bed only, with narrow shadow grooves (not dark orange slats), feature area about 2.8m wide and 1.60m high, low plain ivory upholstered headboard in front, sleek pale oak bedside drawers and tiny opal pendants positioned over bedsides. Cream textured bed linen, pale oak floor and wool rug. Refined not busy.

options.title: Floating calm
options.description: A light bed frame with slender bedsides and warm wall lights.
options.style: Slim floating pale oak bed platform on recessed hidden supports, low biscuit-ivory upholstered headboard, slender wall-mounted pale oak and limestone bedside shelves with one concealed drawer each, shallow sculptural alabaster-look warm wall lights above them. Ivory linen bedding with sand wool throw, small restrained ceramic vase, pale oak floor and ivory rug. Light, uncluttered and contemporary.

options.title: Layered ivory
options.description: Tonal fabric panels, tactile bedding and discreet bronze details.
options.style: Three large horizontal ivory fabric panels create a warm upholstered feature behind the bed to 1.6m high, plain oatmeal upholstered bed frame, pale oak bedside cabinets with subtle bronze recessed pulls, textured ivory ceramic lamps with off-white linen shades. Layer cream and light greige cushions, fine woven rug over pale oak floor. Luxurious soft neutral sanctuary, no tufting or ornate styling.

options.title: Limestone accent
options.description: Warm stone bedside blocks and softly curved linen upholstery.
options.style: A low curved ivory linen headboard and upholstered bed with simple pale oak feet, compact rounded honed creamy limestone bedside blocks with inset pale oak drawer faces, small slender bronze-and-opal lamps. Very subtle warm mineral limewash on existing walls, pale oak floor with ivory wool rug. Precise realistic limestone pores, calm neutral bedding and soft sand blanket.

options.title: Bronze & oak
options.description: Pale timber, slim bronze lighting and a tailored upholstered bed.
options.style: Tailored ivory upholstered headboard set within a thin pale oak surround, understated brushed-bronze seam/reveal at bedsides, small floating oak drawer units with stone tops, elegant slim bronze reading lights plus softly glowing tiny opal globes. Warm white linen with greige herringbone throw, pale oak floor and oatmeal rug. Architectural, quietly luxurious, no mirror walls.

options.title: Sand & linen
options.description: A warmer sand headboard, light oak and relaxed ivory linen.
options.style: Wide softly rounded sand-linen headboard with a slim pale oak cap, pale oak drum bedside cabinets, cream ribbed ceramic lamps, relaxed ivory linen duvet with subtle folds, taupe cashmere-style throw, restrained olive sprig in small stoneware vase. Full-length off-white curtains parked beside existing window without covering most glass; pale oak floor and a creamy loop-pile rug. Warm modern but never rustic.
